title: An older SWERepo never replaces a .swerepo.toml from a newer SWERepo or standard, loaded, new or stale
assertion: An older SWERepo never replaces a .swerepo.toml written by a newer SWERepo version or in a newer standard: not after loading it (it still loads, even naming components this version doesn't know), not with a new state, and not with a state loaded before the newer SWERepo rewrote the file. The file stays unchanged.

origin.text: GitHub Copilot's review of PR #2 found paths the locked rule inv_070db19c promises but its test didn't exercise; the code is fixed (b827f00) and this replacement's test covers them (ADR-20261120-ecf7).
